# Original structural fixtures

The prose, hierarchy and table rows generated by `tests/structure_fixtures.py` are original synthetic material dedicated to CC0-1.0. They contain no standards text, benchmark answers or copied source data. Tests generate PDF bytes locally with ReportLab; downloaded standards are never required by the unit suite.

The fixtures exercise three hierarchy levels, missing levels, repeated titles/numbers, TOC entries, repeated margins, a cross-page clause, an intermediate table, numeric lists, deterministic long-clause partitions, glyph-group boundaries, fallback pages and unsupported geometry. Fixed synthetic tokenizer measurements are used only for unit tests; release-source acceptance uses the resident pinned tokenizers.
